mapper.select: SELECT content_json,status,issued,version FROM benefit_point_offer WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND offer_id=#{id}
SELECT content_json,status,issued,version FROM benefit_point_offer WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND offer_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT content_json,status,issued,version FROM benefit_point_offer WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND offer_id>#{after} AND (#{admin}=true OR (status='ACTIVE' AND valid_from<=#{now} AND valid_to>#{now})) ORDER BY offer_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE benefit_point_offer SET status=CASE WHEN #{input.active} THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END,version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND offer_id=#{id} AND version=#{input.expectedVersion}
UPDATE benefit_point_offer SET issued=issued+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND offer_id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND issued<quota
mapper.select: SELECT redeemed FROM benefit_point_offer_member WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND offer_id=#{id} AND member_id=#{member} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO benefit_point_offer_member(tenant_id,offer_id,member_id,redeemed) VALUES(#{tenant},#{id},#{member},1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE redeemed=redeemed+1
mapper.select: SELECT redemption_id,offer_id,member_id,points,kind,asset_id,created_at FROM benefit_point_redemption WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND redemption_id>#{after} ORDER BY redemption_id LIMIT #{limit}
